Ride

Some rides are worth the crash.

Evelynn Marsano's been gone for a year, but very little's changed. Her brother still rules the underground racing scene. The same girls still hate her. And the same boy still makes her heart race and resolve weak. But this time, she won't let him get close enough to hurt her. Not again. Not like before.

Weston Burke is only in town to set up a few street bike races, make some money, and have a little fun. Getting involved with his sponsor's little sister? That was never part of the plan. Especially when it'll piss off more than just her brothers. It'll wreck everything he's worked for. He knows better, but he can't stop.

Some rides are worth the crash.

RIDE is a standalone romance in the Crowns and Chaos series, an introduction to a world of illegal street racing, ruthless motorcycle clubs, and love that breaks all the rules.
